fluff.overview: The Draconis Combine Mustered Soldiery assigns conventional infantry to garrison roles across its military districts, with district regulars often fielding extra platoons to secure worlds that BattleMech forces cannot permanently garrison. Jump infantry carry jump packs that make them the most mobile troops in the DCMS inventory for urban and broken terrain fighting. The ability to bypass obstacles and seize elevated positions gives these platoons a tactical value that district commanders prize, particularly on heavily built-up garrison worlds where conventional movement is restricted. Their support squads operate portable machine guns that deliver sustained automatic fire at ranges well beyond personal weapons. A single well-placed machine gun team can suppress an entire enemy platoon and threaten light vehicles that would otherwise ignore conventional infantry.
